EC1: Overlap syndrome with Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis [OR] (PSC) or Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) (Paris criteria, strong positive Anti-Mitochondrial Antibodies (AMA), past liver biopsy [OR] or cholangiographic findings compatible with PBC or PSC).
EC2: Presentation with acute liver failure, defined as presence of hepatic encephalopathy and coagulopathy [AND] (INR > 1.5)
EC3: Current treatment with prednisone [OR]/prednisolone [OR] and/or immunosuppressive medication [AND] for an indication [NOT] other than autoimmune hepatitis
EC5: Other clinically significant medical conditions that could interfere with the trial
EC6: If female of childbearing potential: known pregnancy, or unwilling to practice anticontraceptive measures.
EC7: History of noncompliance with medical regimens, or patients who are considered to be potentially unreliable or unable to participate
EC8: Mental instability or incompetence, such that the validity of informed consent or compliance with the trial is uncertain
